title: Correct T2 calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute T2 = 800 K using the isochoric pressure-temperature relation.

title: Correct p3 calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute p3 = (4/3)×10^5 Pa using Boyle's law for the isothermal process.

title: Identify process 1→2
description: Important: Recognize that process 1→2 is isochoric (constant volume) and apply p/T = constant.

title: Identify process 2→3
description: Important: Recognize that the hyperbola in p-V diagram indicates an isothermal process and apply pV = constant.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintain consistent units (Pa, L, K) throughout calculations without conversion errors.

title: Volume recognition for 2→3
description: Important: Use V2 = V1 = 2 L when applying Boyle's law for the 2→3 process.

title: Incorrect process assumption
description: Pitfall: Mistaking the 1→2 process as isobaric or isothermal instead of isochoric.

title: Significant figure handling
description: Optional: Express final answers with appropriate significant figures (800 K, 1.33×10^5 Pa).
